questions.why: The subscription has one attempt and no dead-letter channel.

proposedDecisions.title: Billing gets a dead-letter channel
proposedDecisions.context: Billing consumes order-events with one attempt.
proposedDecisions.decision: Add a dead-letter channel to the Billing subscription.
alternatives: Retry in the consumer: it holds up the messages behind it

proposedDecisions.title: Inventory needs no change
proposedDecisions.context: Inventory has two attempts and a dead-letter channel.
proposedDecisions.decision: Keep the Inventory subscription as it is.

proposedDecisions.title: Mark the design compliant
proposedDecisions.decision: The design is compliant with PCI DSS.
